about.headline: Mobicare Device Recovery
about.lead: We're a locally-owned electronics repair shop in Fairfield, Illinois — serving Wayne County and surrounding areas with honest, fast, quality repairs.
story: Mobicare started with a simple belief: your devices should be repaired by someone who actually cares about doing the job right. As a locally-owned shop, we're not chasing volume — we're building a reputation, one repair at a time.

We fix what the big-box stores won't touch, and we're honest about what can and can't be done. A $35 bench fee covers full diagnostics on every device, so you'll always know the cost before committing to a repair. No surprises, no hidden fees.
We're also expanding into accessories and certified pre-owned devices — making it easier for everyone in southern Illinois to get the gear they need at fair prices.
